title: Daily Temperatures
statement: Given a list of integers temperatures representing daily temperatures, return a list answer such that answer[i] is the number of days you have to wait after day i to get a warmer temperature. If there is no future day with a warmer temperature, put 0 instead.
hints: This is a monotonic-stack problem: maintain a stack of indices whose temperatures are decreasing.
When the current temperature is warmer than the temperature at the index on top of the stack, that index has found its answer.
Pop all indices from the stack that are colder than the current day's temperature, recording the day gap, then push the current index.
